central_distinctions.evidential_relevance: An invariant may remain weak abductive evidence even when its representational provenance has not yet been discriminated.
central_distinctions.individuative_evidential_weight: DR governs whether the invariant is entitled to carry material evidential weight in a structurally supported capacity-identity inference.
central_distinctions.trigger: A scientifically motivated, source-compatible unresolved representation changes an overlap verdict that could be recruited for individuation.
central_distinctions.defeater: If that disputed overlap is actually assigned material individuative weight, the unresolved live alternative undercuts that evidential use until the relevant preservation choice is discriminated.

full_counterexample.systems: two learning systems with distinct update mechanisms
full_counterexample.r_pred: compresses both systems to the same minimal predictive state and can be objectively/scientifically superior for forecasting
full_counterexample.r_mech: independently motivated source-compatible representation that preserves the distinct update mechanisms
full_counterexample.result: R_mech undercuts using the predictive invariant by itself to license same-capacity identity, without establishing that the identity hypothesis is false.
full_counterexample.north_relation: Objective perspicuity with respect to the identity-relevant target can discharge DR; superiority for a different genuine target does not automatically transfer.

claim_boundary: DR does not require complete exclusion of every alternative explanation before an invariant can count as evidence at all.
DR does not require a separate dataset in every case.
DR does not claim capacity identity is false when a live rival is present.
DR does not govern mechanistic or other identity routes that do not assign structural overlap material evidential weight.
